title: C^1 radial cutoff with zeta = 1 on B_{rho/2}(xi), zeta = 0 off the open ball B_rho(xi), and |D zeta| <= 3/rho
statement: For every m in N, xi in R^m (= Rn m = EuclideanSpace R (Fin m)) and rho > 0 there is a C^1 function zeta : R^m -> R such that: 0 <= zeta(x) <= 1 for every x; zeta(x) = 1 for every x in the closed ball B_{rho/2}(xi); zeta(x) = 0 whenever dist(x, xi) >= rho; and ||D zeta(x)|| <= 3/rho for every x, where D zeta(x) = fderiv R zeta x and ||.|| is the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Rn m) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∃ ζ : Rn m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ (ρ / 2), ζ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, ρ ≤ dist x ξ → ζ x = 0) ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ≤ 3 / ρ
